people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

translations.web: The priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in Yahweh’s house.
translations.bsb: Now the priests and prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the LORD,
translations.kjv: So the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the LORD.
translations.asv: And the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of Jehovah.
